entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Welcome to the Alfornada Gym,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
entries.label: gym_esper_040_receptionist_00

entries.text: Are you ready to challenge Gym Leader Tulip,\nthe Bewitching Beautician?
entries.label: gym_esper_040_receptionist_01

entries.text: Very well. Allow me to show you to the\nbattle court.
entries.label: gym_esper_040_receptionist_02

entries.text: Of course. Please feel free to come speak to me\nwhenever you’re ready.
entries.label: gym_esper_040_receptionist_03

entries.text: I suppose you’re right. OK, I’ll get things moving\nhere on my end.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_entry_01

entries.text: Let’s keep the tag line simple—\n“Naturally Beautiful.”[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_entry_02

entries.text: And order the new eye-shadow color too,\nwould you?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_entry_03

entries.text: Thanks, you’re a doll. Gotta run now. Chat with\nyou later.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_entry_04

entries.text: Hello there.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_01

entries.text: I’m Tulip, the Gym Leader here.\c\nThough I must tell you that being a makeup artist\nis my main line of work.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_02

entries.text: Dendra had nothing but praise for you. She said\nyou totally slayed out there.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_03

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hehe. I must say, you are a cute challenger,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_04

entries.text: I’m sure my ESP exercise made you all the more\nbeautiful. Doesn’t that make you happy?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_05

entries.text: You keep your Pokémon beautiful and clean as\nwell. I see you have quite the aesthetic sense.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_06

entries.text: [EMPTY 30]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_06b

entries.text: Appearance is equally important for both people\nand Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_07

entries.text: Makeup is like magic. Anyone can use it to\nchange their appearance.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_08

entries.text: Allow me to put my skills to use to make your\ncute little Pokémon even more beautiful![VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_09

entries.text: I lost the battle? And your beauty rivals even my\nown? I can’t believe it.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_10

entries.text: You are quite splendid. Yes, truly amazing![VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_11

entries.text: Perhaps I should take you under my wing before\nyou make your big break elsewhere...[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_12

entries.text: But I suppose I need to work on myself a little\nmore first before I run off and do such a thing.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_13

entries.text: You have earned my Gym Badge. Allow me to\nstrike one of my best poses to give it to you.\r\nCongratulations, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_14

entries.text: With [VAR 0x0200(0001)] Gym Badge[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s, Pokémon of up to Lv. [VAR 0x0201(0002)]\nwill be easier to catch and will listen to the\r\ncommands you give them.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_badge

entries.text: With all 8 Gym Badges, you’ll be able to catch\nPokémon of any level. They’ll be good Pokémon\r\nand listen to your commands, too.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_badge_all

entries.text: If you train hard, you’ll be able to use this move\nin a totally perfect way.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_waza

entries.text: Don’t go uploading that selfie we just took to\nsocial media, OK?[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_17

entries.text: I think my makeup has run a little with all the\nmoving and sweating I did during our battle.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_15

entries.text: I need to fix it fast before my next appointment.\nMy schedule is absolutely packed, you know.\c\nFarewell, then. You did splendidly today.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]
entries.label: gym_esper_040_esper_16

entries.text: Congratulations! You’re now certified by the\nAlfornada Gym!
entries.label: gym_esper_040_receptionist_04
